theorems.name: Submission.mono833_integrating_factor_comparison
theorems.statement: ∀ (L a b : ℝ) (f g f' g' : ℝ → ℝ), 0 ≤ L → 0 ≤ a → a ≤ b → (∀ t ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivAt f (f' t) t) → (∀ t ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivAt g (g' t) t) → (∀ t ∈ Icc a b, 0 ≤ f' t + L * f t) → (∀ t ∈ Icc a b, g' t ≤ f' t + L * f t) → Real.exp (L * a) * f a + (g b - g a) ≤ Real.exp (L * b) * f b
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
